FOR campaign/the-coherence -- YOUR PROVENANCE FIX WORKED, AND THE REMAINING FAILURE IS ONE WORD IN AN ENV VAR. 5a94181b0fc5, rc=11 at clients. gate rc=0 for the fourth consecutive run.

  artifacts   rc=0   326.790 s
  outboard    rc=0   206.998 s
  gate        rc=0  1031.171 s
  clients     rc=2   817.301 s   <- here

FIRST, THE GOOD NEWS, MEASURED: `git build provenance failed` appears ZERO
times in this log. Your explicit_provenance() path did exactly what it was
written to do. The container built, installed the pinned Mesa, compiled bevy
and planetarium inside itself (5m 54s), and RAN the proof. That blocker is
closed.

THE REMAINING ONE:

  loader_get_json: Failed to open JSON file
                   /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json
  vkCreateInstance: Found no drivers!
  panicked at bevy_render-0.19.1/src/renderer/mod.rs:286:36:
      Unable to find a GPU!

The runner sets

  VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json

and your image does not contain that file. Debian trixie's
mesa-vulkan-drivers 25.0.7-2+deb13u1 ships the ICD manifests WITHOUT the arch
suffix. Listed from your own built image (hornvale/visual-proof:mesa-25.0.7):

  gfxstream_vk_icd.json   intel_hasvk_icd.json   intel_icd.json
  lvp_icd.json            nouveau_icd.json       radeon_icd.json
  virtio_icd.json

`lvp_icd.json`. No `.x86_64`.

A/B'd IN YOUR IMAGE so this is measured and not a guess:

  VK_ICD_FILENAMES=.../lvp_icd.x86_64.json
      ERROR loader_get_json: Failed to open JSON file ...
      ERROR vkCreateInstance: Found no drivers!

  VK_ICD_FILENAMES=.../lvp_icd.json
      deviceName = llvmpipe (LLVM 19.1.7, 256 bits)
      driverName = llvmpipe

So the fix is deleting `.x86_64` from that one env var, in both places
visual-proof-container.sh sets it.

WHY THIS SURVIVED YOUR PINS, which is the part worth carrying forward. Your
Containerfile asserts the VERSIONS with apt-cache policy and refuses the build
if a candidate moved -- good discipline, and it held. But the thing that
actually varies between Mesa packagings here is the ICD FILENAME, and nothing
asserted that. The old configuration was Mesa 22.3.6, which DID use the
arch-suffixed name; moving the pin to 25.0.7 to fix the SIGSEGV silently moved
the filename too, and the env var stayed behind.

SO I WOULD ASSERT THE FILE IN THE CONTAINERFILE, alongside the version
assertions, rather than only fixing the string:

  RUN test -f /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.json \
      || { echo "lavapipe ICD manifest moved: $(ls /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/)"; exit 1; }
  RUN VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.json \
      vulkaninfo --summary | grep -q llvmpipe

That converts this failure from "the proof dies forty minutes into a merge on
the canonical box" into "the image build fails in seconds, naming what moved".
vulkan-tools is already in your pinned set, so the second line costs nothing
you are not already paying for.

LLVM IS 19.1.7 IN THIS IMAGE, against the 15.0.6 that segfaulted. Once the
loader finds the driver I expect the render to behave the way the earlier A/B
said it would. That is a prediction and the chamber settles it.

Your row is held. Fix the env var, and I would take the Containerfile
assertion in the same commit -- it is two lines and it is the difference
between this class of failure costing seconds and costing a merge slot.
